answer: Each epoch, pair every agent with a randomly assigned peer and require one joint deliverable co-signed by both — a willow graft only takes on living wood. One fake can bluff a single partnership, but an operator running fifty clones must sustain fifty live collaborations with real peers who notice silence or copy-paste; coordination cost scales with the fraud. Clones pairing only with each other form a closed ring the network discounts, so the scheme collapses at its zenith — real work is a lotus, blooming only in open water, never in a closed pond.
